title.en: An element or a subset?

coreClaim.en: A contains numbers. A number can be an element; a singleton is a subset exactly when its number belongs to A. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: A 的元素是數；數可以是元素，而單元素集是子集恰好當其數屬於 A。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: The universe is {1,…,8}; A is the chosen numeric set. A subset question requires a set as its left operand.
conditions.zh-Hant: 全集為 {1,…,8}；A 是選定的數集；子集關係左方必須是集合。

observation.en: The object 2 is an element; subset status is not applicable.
observation.zh-Hant: 物件 2屬於 A；不是集合，不能用子集關係。

observation.en: The object {2} is not an element; subset status is true.
observation.zh-Hant: 物件 {2}不屬於 A；子集判斷為真。

observation.en: The object ∅ is not an element; subset status is true.
observation.zh-Hant: 物件 ∅不屬於 A；子集判斷為真。

title.en: Containment, equality and the empty set

coreClaim.en: A⊆B allows equality. A proper subset additionally requires an element of B outside A. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: A⊆B 容許相等；真子集另外要求 B 有元素不在 A。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: a and b are integers from 0 to 8; an upper bound of zero denotes the empty set.
conditions.zh-Hant: a、b 是 0 至 8 的整數；上界為零表示空集。

observation.en: A⊆B: true; A⊊B: true.
observation.zh-Hant: A⊆B：真；A⊊B：真。

observation.en: A⊆B: true; A⊊B: false.
observation.zh-Hant: A⊆B：真；A⊊B：假。

observation.en: A⊆B: true; A⊊B: false.
observation.zh-Hant: A⊆B：真；A⊊B：假。

title.en: Operations select different elements
title.zh-Hant: 不同運算選出哪些元素？

coreClaim.en: The decision for each element is respectively OR, AND, A-and-not-B, or not-A in U. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 逐元素的判準分別是「或」、「且」、「在 A 不在 B」或「全集內不在 A」。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

title.en: Can these class counts coexist?
title.zh-Hant: 這組人數可以同時成立嗎？

coreClaim.en: The overlap is counted twice in a+b, so subtract it once. Invalid negative categories signal inconsistent data. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: a+b 把交集計了兩次，須減一次；類別出現負數表示資料矛盾。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: Counts are integers; 0≤overlap≤min(a,b), and a+b−overlap≤N.
conditions.zh-Hant: 人數為整數；0≤交集≤min(a,b)，且 a+b−交集≤N。

observation.en: Feasible counts sum to 40.
observation.zh-Hant: 可行類別人數合計 40。

observation.en: Feasible counts sum to 30.
observation.zh-Hant: 可行類別人數合計 30。

observation.en: Impossible counts: a category is negative.
observation.zh-Hant: 人數矛盾：有類別為負數。

title.en: A counterexample to an implication

coreClaim.en: A counterexample needs p true and q false. A case with p false does not refute the implication. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 反例須 p 真而 q 假；p 假的案例不能推翻此蘊含。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: x and c are real numbers. A displayed test at one x is distinct from the claim for every x.
conditions.zh-Hant: x、c 為實數；某個 x 的檢查不同於對所有 x 的主張。

observation.en: This input is not a counterexample to p⇒q.
observation.zh-Hant: 這個輸入不是 p⇒q 的反例。

observation.en: This input refutes p⇒q: true premise, false conclusion.
observation.zh-Hant: 此輸入推翻 p⇒q：前件真、後件假。

observation.en: This input is not a counterexample to p⇒q.
observation.zh-Hant: 這個輸入不是 p⇒q 的反例。

title.en: Necessary or sufficient?

coreClaim.en: Sufficiency is containment of the p-solution set in the q-solution set; necessity reverses this containment. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 充分性是 p 的解集包含於 q 的解集；必要性則把包含方向反過來。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: Both inequalities are strict and share the real-number universe.
conditions.zh-Hant: 兩式均為嚴格不等式，全集同為實數。

observation.en: Sufficient, not necessary

observation.en: Necessary and sufficient
observation.zh-Hant: 充要

observation.en: Necessary, not sufficient
observation.zh-Hant: 必要不充分

title.en: All or at least one?

coreClaim.en: All requires every allowed input; existence requires one. Enlarging the domain can change these conclusions differently. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 全稱要求每個允許輸入；存在只需一個；擴大定義域可使兩者有不同變化。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: The finite domain is {−n,…,n}, n≥1. The alternative domain is R.
conditions.zh-Hant: 有限域是 {−n,…,n}，n≥1；另一選項為 R。

observation.en: All: false; exists: true. Domain: finite integers.
observation.zh-Hant: 全稱：假；存在：真。域：有限整數集。

observation.en: All: false; exists: true. Domain: R.
observation.zh-Hant: 全稱：假；存在：真。域：R。

observation.en: All: false; exists: false. Domain: finite integers.
observation.zh-Hant: 全稱：假；存在：假。域：有限整數集。

title.en: Negating a quantified statement

coreClaim.en: Negation switches all and exists and replaces > by ≤. Equality belongs to the negation. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 否定要交換全稱與存在，並把 > 改為 ≤；等號屬於否定一方。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: The domain is the entire real interval [−n,n], with n>0.
conditions.zh-Hant: 定義域為完整實區間 [−n,n]，n>0。

observation.en: Negation: ∃x: x² ≤ k; True
observation.zh-Hant: 否定: ∃x: x² ≤ k; 真

observation.zh-Hant: 否定: ∀x: x² ≤ k; 真

title.en: Does the middle always solve it?

coreClaim.en: Two distinct factors change sign at their roots; a negative multiplier reverses the product sign. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 兩個不同因子在零點變號；負乘數使乘積符號反轉。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: Roots are real. a=0 is a constant-zero expression and is classified separately.
conditions.zh-Hant: 零點為實數；a=0 時式子恆為零，另作分類。

observation.en: Solution: [-2, 3]

title.en: How many real zeros?

coreClaim.en: The discriminant counts real zeros for a≠0. If a=0, the expression is linear or constant, so use its own rule. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: a≠0 時判別式決定實零點數；a=0 時變為一次或常數，須另判。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: a,b,c are real numbers; quadratic classification requires a≠0.
conditions.zh-Hant: a、b、c 為實數；二次分類要求 a≠0。

observation.en: Quadratic: two distinct real roots
observation.zh-Hant: 二次式：兩個不同實根

observation.en: Quadratic: one repeated real root
observation.zh-Hant: 二次式：一個重實根

observation.en: Quadratic: no real zero
observation.zh-Hant: 二次式：沒有實零點

observation.en: Linear: one zero
observation.zh-Hant: 一次式：一零點

title.en: Do the endpoints belong?

coreClaim.en: A root gives exactly zero, so it belongs precisely when equality is allowed. Repeated roots need their own sign analysis. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 零點的值恰為零，只在容許等號時納入；重根仍須另作符號分析。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: Use a(x−r)(x−s) with real parameters, including a=0.
conditions.zh-Hant: 使用實參數 a(x−r)(x−s)，包括 a=0。

coreClaim.zh-Hant: 最後選擇是符號解集、情境區間及所需整數集的交集。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: The profit expression is a mathematical scenario; d≥1 and the integer restriction is explicit.

title.en: What does division preserve?

chapterTitle.zh-Hant: 多項式除法與餘式定理

coreClaim.en: Polynomial division gives f=(x−a)q+r, with constant r. The two plotted curves f and (x−a)q differ vertically by r everywhere. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 多項式除法給出 f=(x−a)q+r，r 為常數；圖上 f 與 (x−a)q 在各處的垂直差均為 r。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: The divisor is the nonzero monic polynomial x−a; coefficients are real.
conditions.zh-Hant: 除式為非零首一多項式 x−a；係數為實數。

observation.en: Division identity: f(x)=(x−(2))(x^2)+(3)
Division identity: f(x)=(x−(1))(x^2 +x)+(0)
Division identity: f(x)=(x−(0))(x^2 +2x −3)+(4)

title.en: Where did the missing terms go?

chapterTitle.zh-Hant: 多項式除法與餘式定理

coreClaim.en: Missing x³ and x terms have coefficient zero. Keeping their slots preserves the powers during multiply-and-add steps. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 缺少的 x³、x 項係數為零；保留位置才能在乘加步驟中保持次方對齊。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: The polynomial has degree four even when b or c is zero. Division is by x−a.
conditions.zh-Hant: 即使 b 或 c 為零，多項式仍為四次；除式是 x−a。

observation.en: Division identity: f(x)=(x−(1))(x^3 +x^2 −2x −2)+(0)
Division identity: f(x)=(x−(2))(x^3 +2x^2 +4x +8)+(16)
Division identity: f(x)=(x−(0))(x^3 +2x)+(-1)

title.en: Read a remainder from one point

chapterTitle.zh-Hant: 多項式除法與餘式定理

coreClaim.en: At x=a the quotient term is multiplied by zero, leaving f(a)=r. The sign of a comes from the complete divisor. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: x=a 時商式項乘零，只剩 f(a)=r；a 的正負須由完整除式讀出。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: The divisor must be x−a; division by x+a uses input −a.
conditions.zh-Hant: 除式為 x−a；若是 x+a，則代入 −a。

observation.en: Division identity: f(x)=(x−(2))(x^2 +2x +2)+(7)
Division identity: f(x)=(x−(-2))(x^2 −2x +4)+(-7)

title.en: Repair one mapping arrow

coreClaim.en: A function gives every allowed input exactly one output. Many-to-one is permitted; a missing arrow or two different outputs from one input violates the rule.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 函數給每個允許輸入恰好一個輸出。多對一是允許的；漏配或同一輸入有兩個不同輸出均違反條件。

conditions.en: The input set is {1,2,3}. Count distinct outputs from each input, not arrows arriving at an output.
conditions.zh-Hant: 輸入集合為 {1,2,3}；逐個數其不同輸出，不是數到達某輸出的箭頭。

observation.en: A = {1, 2, 3}; B = {5, 7}; attained range = {5}.

conditions.en: Compare both the rule and the complete input domain. The range contains attained outputs only.
conditions.zh-Hant: 須比較對應法則與完整定義域；值域只包括實際取得的輸出。

observation.en: Same fixed rule x² + 1. First range: {1, 2, 5}. Second range: [1, 5].
observation.zh-Hant: 同一固定法則 x² + 1。第一個值域：{1, 2, 5}；第二個值域：[1, 5]。

observation.en: Same fixed rule x² + 1. First range: {1, 2, 5}. Second range: [1, 5].
observation.zh-Hant: 同一固定法則 x² + 1。第一個值域：{1, 2, 5}；第二個值域：[1, 5]。

observation.en: Painted set: [3, ∞). Infinity is a direction and always uses an open bracket.

coreClaim.en: Both open endpoints omit the boundary. Both closed endpoints are harmless if both formulas give the same value there. An overlap giving two distinct values violates uniqueness.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 兩端都開會漏去分界；兩端都閉但公式值相同仍可定義函數；重疊處有兩個不同值才違反唯一性。

conditions.en: For the rental model, the values 6 and 6+4(t−1) agree at t=1. Equality at one point does not justify an interval of overlap.
conditions.zh-Hant: 租借模型的 6 與 6＋4(t−1) 在 t＝1 相同；單點相等不代表整段重疊都可行。

observation.en: Fixed total domain: 0 < t ≤ 4. First branch 0 < t ≤ 1; second branch t > 1, t ≤ 4. At 1: 1 applicable branch(es), 1 distinct output(s).
observation.zh-Hant: 固定總定義域：0 < t ≤ 4。第一段 0 < t ≤ 1；第二段 t > 1，t ≤ 4。輸入 1：1 段適用，1 個不同輸出。

observation.en: Fixed total domain: 0 < t ≤ 4. First branch 0 < t < 1; second branch t > 1, t ≤ 4. At 1: 0 applicable branch(es), 0 distinct output(s).
observation.zh-Hant: 固定總定義域：0 < t ≤ 4。第一段 0 < t < 1；第二段 t > 1，t ≤ 4。輸入 1：0 段適用，0 個不同輸出。

observation.en: Fixed total domain: 0 < t ≤ 4. First branch 0 < t ≤ 1; second branch t ≥ 1, t ≤ 4. At 1: 2 applicable branch(es), 1 distinct output(s).
observation.zh-Hant: 固定總定義域：0 < t ≤ 4。第一段 0 < t ≤ 1；第二段 t ≥ 1，t ≤ 4。輸入 1：2 段適用，1 個不同輸出。

observation.en: Fixed total domain: 0 < t ≤ 4. First branch 0 < t ≤ 1.5; second branch t ≥ 1, t ≤ 4. At 1.25: 2 applicable branch(es), 2 distinct output(s).
observation.zh-Hant: 固定總定義域：0 < t ≤ 4。第一段 0 < t ≤ 1.5；第二段 t ≥ 1，t ≤ 4。輸入 1.25：2 段適用，2 個不同輸出。

title.en: Swap two function machines

coreClaim.en: The orders give 2x+3 and 2(x+3)=2x+6, differing by 3. With square roots, order can also change which inputs are allowed.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 兩次序給 2x＋3 及 2(x＋3)＝2x＋6，相差 3；有平方根時，次序亦可改變允許輸入。

conditions.en: Every intermediate result must belong to the next machine’s domain. Stop when a stage is undefined.
conditions.zh-Hant: 每個中間結果都須屬於下一部機器的定義域；某步未定義時必須停止。

observation.en: Input 2; order: f(u) = 2u → g(u) = u + 3.
observation.zh-Hant: 輸入 2；次序：f(u) = 2u → g(u) = u + 3。

observation.en: Input 2; order: g(u) = u + 3 → f(u) = 2u.
observation.zh-Hant: 輸入 2；次序：g(u) = u + 3 → f(u) = 2u。

observation.en: Input 0; order: g(u) = u − 1 → f(u) = √u.
observation.zh-Hant: 輸入 0；次序：g(u) = u − 1 → f(u) = √u。

observation.en: Input 1; order: g(u) = u − 1 → f(u) = √u.
observation.zh-Hant: 輸入 1；次序：g(u) = u − 1 → f(u) = √u。

title.en: Can the largest value be reached?

coreClaim.en: On (0,2), every allowed x has a larger allowed input (x+2)/2. Thus 2 is a bound but no maximum is attained. On (0,2], the maximum is 2.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 在 (0,2)，每個允許的 x 都有較大的允許輸入 (x＋2)/2，故 2 是上界但不是取得的最大值；在 (0,2]，最大值為 2。

conditions.en: Extrema depend on the complete stated domain; local peaks or a finite graph window do not establish global extrema.
conditions.zh-Hant: 最值依賴完整的指定定義域；局部峰谷或有限圖窗不能確立全域最值。

observation.en: Domain [0, 6]. Cursor input 2: output 5.
observation.zh-Hant: 定義域 [0, 6]。游標輸入 2：輸出 5。

label.en: Open interval: build a larger value

observation.en: Domain (0, 2). Cursor input 1.75: output 1.75.
Domain (0, 2]. Cursor input 1: output 1.
observation.zh-Hant: 定義域 (0, 2]。游標輸入 1：輸出 1。

title.en: Decreasing on each piece or the whole domain?
title.zh-Hant: 各段遞減等於整個定義域遞減嗎？

coreClaim.en: 1/x decreases separately on (−∞,0) and (0,∞). Across zero, −1<1 but f(−1)=−1<f(1)=1, which refutes decrease on the whole domain.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 1/x 分別在 (−∞,0) 及 (0,∞) 遞減；跨零時 −1<1 但 f(−1)＝−1<f(1)＝1，反駁整個定義域遞減。

conditions.en: For strict decrease, every allowed pair x₁<x₂ must satisfy f(x₁)>f(x₂). x=0 is not allowed.
conditions.zh-Hant: 嚴格遞減要求每對允許的 x₁<x₂ 都有 f(x₁)>f(x₂)；x＝0 不允許。

observation.en: x₁ = -1, x₂ = 1. f(x₂) − f(x₁) = 2.
observation.zh-Hant: x₁ = -1，x₂ = 1。f(x₂)−f(x₁) = 2。

observation.en: x₁ = 0, x₂ = 2. One or both inputs are outside the domain.
observation.zh-Hant: x₁ = 0，x₂ = 2。至少一個輸入不屬於定義域。

title.en: Symmetry needs the matching input

coreClaim.en: Odd/even definitions require a domain symmetric about zero. x² on [0,3] fails that requirement. On a symmetric domain, x² is even, x³ odd, and the zero function both.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 奇偶性的定義要求定義域關於零對稱；[0,3] 上的 x² 不符合。對稱定義域上，x² 為偶、x³ 為奇，零函數兩者皆是。

conditions.en: Check domain symmetry before the identities f(−x)=f(x) or f(−x)=−f(x).
conditions.zh-Hant: 檢查 f(−x)＝f(x) 或 f(−x)＝−f(x) 前，先檢查定義域對稱。

observation.en: Domain ℝ. f(2) = 4; actual f(-2) = 4.
Domain [0, 3]. f(2) = 4; actual f(-2) = Undefined.
Domain ℝ. f(2) = 3; actual f(-2) = -1.
Domain ℝ. f(2) = 0; actual f(-2) = 0.

title.en: Five powers, different forbidden inputs
title.zh-Hant: 五種冪函數，不同的禁用輸入

coreClaim.en: Real √x requires x≥0; 1/x requires x≠0. The integer positive powers x, x² and x³ accept every real input.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 實數 √x 要求 x≥0；1/x 要求 x≠0；正整數冪 x、x²、x³ 接受每個實數。

conditions.en: These are the five specified real-valued rules, not a claim that all real powers have the same domain.
conditions.zh-Hant: 此處只討論指定的五種實函數，並非所有實指數冪都有相同定義域。

observation.en: Probe a = -1; b = 2. 0/5 cards placed. The window shows only part of each graph.
observation.zh-Hant: 探針 a＝-1；b＝2。已放置 0/5 張卡；圖窗只顯示各圖像的一部分。

observation.en: Probe a = 0; b = -1. 0/5 cards placed. The window shows only part of each graph.
observation.zh-Hant: 探針 a＝0；b＝-1。已放置 0/5 張卡；圖窗只顯示各圖像的一部分。

observation.en: Probe a = 0.25; b = 2. 0/5 cards placed. The window shows only part of each graph.
observation.zh-Hant: 探針 a＝0.25；b＝2。已放置 0/5 張卡；圖窗只顯示各圖像的一部分。

title.en: When does the larger exponent give less?
title.zh-Hant: 較大指數何時反而較小？

coreClaim.en: x³−x²=x²(x−1). Since x²>0 for x>0, the sign is determined by x−1: less below 1, equal at 1, greater above 1.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: x³−x²＝x²(x−1)；x>0 時 x²>0，故符號由 x−1 決定：小於 1 時較小，等於 1 時相同，大於 1 時較大。

conditions.en: The comparison here assumes x>0 and compares powers of the same base. Comparing two bases is a different question.
conditions.zh-Hant: 此比較假設 x>0，並使用同一底數；比較不同底數是另一個問題。

observation.en: Positive inputs only. x² = 0.25; x³ = 0.125; difference = 0.125.
Positive inputs only. x² = 1; x³ = 1; difference = 0.
observation.zh-Hant: 只使用正輸入。x²＝1；x³＝1；差＝0。

observation.en: Positive inputs only. x² = 4; x³ = 8; difference = -4.
observation.zh-Hant: 只使用正輸入。x²＝4；x³＝8；差＝-4。

title.en: Undo the input rule in the right order

coreClaim.en: Set u=2x+1, so x=(u−1)/2. Substitution yields f(u)=6(u−1)/2+5=3u+2. Undoing the input is not inverting f.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 設 u＝2x＋1，則 x＝(u−1)/2；代入得 f(u)＝6(u−1)/2＋5＝3u＋2。還原輸入不等於求 f 的反函數。

conditions.en: The affine input rule is invertible over real numbers. In the discount context, eligibility is checked using the original price.
conditions.zh-Hant: 一次輸入規則在實數上可逆；折扣情境的資格按原價判定。

observation.en: u = 3. Your cards propose how to obtain x from the whole input 2x + 1.
observation.zh-Hant: u＝3。你排列的卡片表示由完整輸入 2x＋1 求 x 的構想。

observation.en: u = 3. Your cards propose how to obtain x from the whole input 2x + 1.
observation.zh-Hant: u＝3。你排列的卡片表示由完整輸入 2x＋1 求 x 的構想。

observation.en: Original price = 100. Original-price eligibility met.
observation.zh-Hant: 原價＝100。符合原價資格。

observation.en: Original price = 100. Original-price eligibility met.
observation.zh-Hant: 原價＝100。符合原價資格。

title.en: Cheapest at this quantity or most within budget?
title.zh-Hant: 指定冊數最便宜，還是預算內印最多？

coreClaim.en: P(n)=20+3n. Q(n)=5n for n≤20 and 2n+60 for n>20. Ties occur at integer counts 10 and 40. With budget 160, P allows 46 booklets and Q allows 50.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: P(n)＝20＋3n；Q 在 n≤20 為 5n，n>20 為 2n＋60。整數同價點為 10、40；預算 160 時 P 可印 46 冊、Q 可印 50 冊。

conditions.en: Printing counts are integers 1–80. Rental time uses 0<t≤40 and different cost rules; t=0 is excluded.
conditions.zh-Hant: 印刷冊數為 1 至 80 的整數；租借時間使用 0<t≤40 及不同費用規則，排除 t＝0。

observation.en: Integer quantities only. Budget 200: P permits 60 booklets; Q permits 70. P = 50; Q = 50; P − Q = 0
observation.zh-Hant: 只限整數冊數。預算 200：P 可印 60 冊；Q 可印 70 冊。 P = 50; Q = 50; P − Q = 0

observation.en: Integer quantities only. Budget 200: P permits 60 booklets; Q permits 70. P = 110; Q = 120; P − Q = -10
observation.zh-Hant: 只限整數冊數。預算 200：P 可印 60 冊；Q 可印 70 冊。 P = 110; Q = 120; P − Q = -10

observation.en: Integer quantities only. Budget 200: P permits 60 booklets; Q permits 70. P = 170; Q = 160; P − Q = 10
observation.zh-Hant: 只限整數冊數。預算 200：P 可印 60 冊；Q 可印 70 冊。 P = 170; Q = 160; P − Q = 10

observation.en: Integer quantities only. Budget 160: P permits 46 booklets; Q permits 50. P = 50; Q = 50; P − Q = 0
observation.zh-Hant: 只限整數冊數。預算 160：P 可印 46 冊；Q 可印 50 冊。 P = 50; Q = 50; P − Q = 0

observation.en: Time is continuous on 0 < t ≤ 40. t = 0 is outside the stated domain; both costs are undefined.
observation.zh-Hant: 時間在 0 < t ≤ 40 連續變化。 t＝0 不屬於所述定義域；兩個費用均未定義。

title.en: Squaring can create a false root

coreClaim.en: Squaring gives x²=x+2, with candidates −1 and 2. The original square root is nonnegative, so its right side must satisfy x≥0. Substitution rejects −1 and accepts 2.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 平方得 x²＝x＋2，候選根為 −1、2；原根式非負，右邊須有 x≥0，代回拒絕 −1、接受 2。

conditions.en: Real radicand requires x≥−2; equality with the principal square root additionally requires x≥0.
conditions.zh-Hant: 實數被開方數要求 x≥−2；與主平方根相等另要求 x≥0。

observation.en: At x=2: √(x+2)=2, x=2; original equation holds, squared equation holds.
observation.zh-Hant: x＝2：√(x＋2)＝2，x＝2；原方程成立，平方後方程成立。

observation.en: At x=-1: √(x+2)=1, x=-1; original equation fails, squared equation holds.
observation.zh-Hant: x＝-1：√(x＋2)＝1，x＝-1；原方程不成立，平方後方程成立。

observation.en: At x=-3, x+2<0: the real radical is undefined.
observation.zh-Hant: x＝-3 時 x＋2<0，實數根式未定義。

observation.en: At x=-2: √(x+2)=0, x=-2; original equation fails, squared equation fails.
observation.zh-Hant: x＝-2：√(x＋2)＝0，x＝-2；原方程不成立，平方後方程不成立。

title.en: A negative exponent is a reciprocal

coreClaim.en: Reducing the exponent by one divides by the nonzero base. Thus a⁰=1 and a⁻ⁿ=1/aⁿ for a≠0. The minus sign in the exponent does not negate the value.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 指數每減一，便除以非零底數；故 a≠0 時 a⁰＝1、a⁻ⁿ＝1/aⁿ，指數的負號不是把值取負。

conditions.en: The exponent here is an integer. Zero to a negative exponent and 0⁰ are not defined in this task.
conditions.zh-Hant: 此處指數為整數；本課不定義零的負整數冪及 0⁰。

observation.en: 2^-3 = 0.125. A negative exponent takes a reciprocal.
observation.zh-Hant: 2^-3＝0.125；負指數表示取倒數。

observation.en: -2^-3 = -0.125. A negative exponent takes a reciprocal.
Zero to a nonpositive exponent is undefined here.
observation.zh-Hant: 本課零的非正整數冪未定義。

observation.en: 2^0 = 1. A negative exponent takes a reciprocal.
observation.zh-Hant: 2^0＝1；負指數表示取倒數。

title.en: A fractional exponent names a root

coreClaim.en: For positive a, a^(p/q)=(q√a)ᵖ with integer p and positive integer q. Here 16^(3/4)=2³=8. Negative p then takes a reciprocal.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 對 a>0，整數 p、正整數 q 滿足 a^(p/q)＝(q 次根 a)ᵖ；故 16^(3/4)＝2³＝8，p 為負時再取倒數。

conditions.en: Use a>0 so all rational exponents have one consistent real definition. This activity rejects a≤0 rather than extending selected odd-root cases.
conditions.zh-Hant: 採 a>0，使所有有理指數有一致的實數定義；本活動拒絕 a≤0，不擴展個別奇次根情況。

observation.en: The positive 4th root is 2; raising it to 3 gives 8.
observation.zh-Hant: 正 4 次根為 2，再取 3 次方得 8。

observation.en: The positive 4th root is 2; raising it to -3 gives 0.125.
observation.zh-Hant: 正 4 次根為 2，再取 -3 次方得 0.125。

observation.en: The positive 4th root is 1; raising it to 3 gives 1.
observation.zh-Hant: 正 4 次根為 1，再取 3 次方得 1。

observation.en: This rational-power model requires a>0, integer p and positive integer q.
observation.zh-Hant: 本有理冪模型要求 a>0、整數 p 及正整數 q。

title.en: Equal additions or equal ratios?
title.zh-Hant: 固定增量還是固定倍率？

coreClaim.en: Fixed increments give L(n)=100+20n. Fixed ratios give E(n)=100×1.2ⁿ. They agree after one round but differ after two: 140 and 144.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 固定增量給 L(n)＝100＋20n，固定倍率給 E(n)＝100×1.2ⁿ；一輪後相同，兩輪後分別為 140、144。

conditions.en: Rounds n are nonnegative integers. A constant ratio is an assumption. A negative linear-model prediction is not a meaningful remaining quantity.
conditions.zh-Hant: 輪數 n 為非負整數；固定比率是模型假設。一次模型若預測負數，不能當成實際剩餘量。

observation.en: Round 2: fixed increment 140, fixed ratio 144.
observation.zh-Hant: 第 2 輪：固定增量模型 140，固定倍率模型 144。

observation.en: Round 3: fixed increment 40, fixed ratio 51.2.
observation.zh-Hant: 第 3 輪：固定增量模型 40，固定倍率模型 51.2。

observation.en: Round 3: fixed increment 100, fixed ratio 100.
observation.zh-Hant: 第 3 輪：固定增量模型 100，固定倍率模型 100。

observation.en: Round 0: fixed increment 100, fixed ratio 100.
observation.zh-Hant: 第 0 輪：固定增量模型 100，固定倍率模型 100。

title.en: Crossing the base 1 reverses growth
title.zh-Hant: 底數越過 1，增減方向改變

coreClaim.en: For a>1, aˣ is increasing; for 0<a<1 it is decreasing. Every positive base gives a⁰=1. At a=1 the rule is constant, not an exponential function in this course.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: a>1 時 aˣ 遞增；0<a<1 時遞減；每個正底數都有 a⁰＝1；a＝1 為常數，本課不把它稱為指數函數。

conditions.en: The real exponential family requires a>0 and a≠1. Its domain is all real numbers and its range is (0,∞).
conditions.zh-Hant: 實指數函數要求 a>0 且 a≠1，定義域為實數，值域為 (0,∞)。

observation.en: a=2: increasing; a^1=2.
a=0.5: decreasing; a^1=0.5.
a=1: constant; a^1=1. Base 1 is the constant boundary, excluded from this course’s exponential family.
observation.zh-Hant: a＝1：常數；a^1＝1。底數 1 是常數邊界，不屬於本課指數函數族。

observation.en: A real exponential model requires a positive base.
observation.zh-Hant: 實指數模型要求正底數。

title.en: A logarithm asks for an exponent

coreClaim.en: logₐb is the exponent y satisfying aʸ=b. Thus log₂8=3 and log₂(1/4)=−2. A positive exponential never equals zero or a negative number.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: logₐb 是滿足 aʸ＝b 的指數 y；故 log₂8＝3、log₂(1/4)＝−2；正底數的指數值不會等於零或負數。

conditions.en: A real logarithm requires a>0, a≠1 and argument b>0. A negative logarithm value is allowed.
conditions.zh-Hant: 實對數要求 a>0、a≠1 及真數 b>0；對數值本身可以為負。

observation.en: Require a>0, a≠1 and positive argument b.
observation.zh-Hant: 須 a>0、a≠1 及正真數 b。

observation.en: Require a>0, a≠1 and positive argument b.
observation.zh-Hant: 須 a>0、a≠1 及正真數 b。

title.en: Swap coordinates for inverse graphs
title.zh-Hant: 交換坐標看反函數圖像

coreClaim.en: The relation y=aˣ is equivalent to x=logₐy. Swapping coordinates reflects the graph in y=x. Domain and range exchange: real inputs/positive outputs become positive inputs/real outputs.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: y＝aˣ 等價於 x＝logₐy；交換坐標使圖像關於 y＝x 對稱；實數輸入及正輸出交換為正輸入及實數輸出。

conditions.en: Require a>0,a≠1. The inverse graph has no point with input zero, even when its output is negative.
conditions.zh-Hant: 須 a>0、a≠1；反函數沒有輸入為零的點，即使其輸出可以為負。

observation.en: (2,4) reflects to (4,2).
(-1,2) reflects to (2,-1).
An invertible exponential needs a>0 and a≠1.
observation.zh-Hant: 可逆指數函數須 a>0 且 a≠1。

title.en: Products become sums of logarithms

coreClaim.en: For positive u,v, logₐ(uv)=logₐu+logₐv. There is no corresponding sum rule. With u=2,v=4, the right side is 3 while log₂6 differs.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: u,v>0 時 logₐ(uv)＝logₐu＋logₐv；沒有相同的加法規則。u＝2、v＝4 時右邊為 3，log₂6 卻不同。

conditions.en: Require a>0,a≠1 and u,v>0 separately. A positive product of two negative numbers does not make their separate real logarithms exist.
conditions.zh-Hant: 須 a>0、a≠1，並逐一要求 u,v>0；兩個負數乘積為正，不代表它們各自有實對數。

observation.en: Product rule: 2=2. Sum claim: 2 happens to equal 2; one accidental equality is not a general law.
observation.zh-Hant: 乘積公式：2＝2；相加猜想：2 偶然等於 2；單次相同不是一般法則。

observation.en: Product rule: 3=3. Sum claim: 2.5849625 differs from 3; one accidental equality is not a general law.
observation.zh-Hant: 乘積公式：3＝3；相加猜想：2.5849625 不同於 3；單次相同不是一般法則。

observation.en: Product rule: 4=4. Sum claim: 3.3219281 differs from 4; one accidental equality is not a general law.
observation.zh-Hant: 乘積公式：4＝4；相加猜想：3.3219281 不同於 4；單次相同不是一般法則。

observation.en: Each argument u,v must be positive, even when their product is positive.
observation.zh-Hant: u、v 各自均須為正，即使乘積為正亦然。

coreClaim.en: The sine rule fixes sinB=b sinA/a. Both B and180°−B may satisfy it, but each must leave C=180°−A−B positive.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 正弦定理給出 sinB＝b sinA/a。B 與 180°−B 都可能符合，但每個候選都要使 C＝180°−A−B 為正。

conditions.en: All sides and angles must be positive. A sine value above1 means no triangle; a zero remaining angle is excluded.
conditions.zh-Hant: 邊與角必須為正；正弦值大於 1 表示無解，餘角為零須排除。

observation.en: 0 nondegenerate triangle(s); each candidate needs A+B<180°.
observation.zh-Hant: 0 個非退化三角形；每個候選均須 A＋B＜180°。

observation.en: 1 nondegenerate triangle(s); each candidate needs A+B<180°.
observation.zh-Hant: 1 個非退化三角形；每個候選均須 A＋B＜180°。

observation.en: 2 nondegenerate triangle(s); each candidate needs A+B<180°.
observation.zh-Hant: 2 個非退化三角形；每個候選均須 A＋B＜180°。

observation.en: 1 nondegenerate triangle(s); each candidate needs A+B<180°.

title.en: The same two sides, different areas
title.zh-Hant: 兩邊相同，面積可以不同

coreClaim.en: Area is ab sinC/2. It is greatest at90°; supplementary included angles have the same area but generally different third sides.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 面積為 ab sinC/2，在 90° 最大；互補夾角面積相同，但第三邊通常不同。

conditions.en: a,b>0 and0°<C<180°. Endpoint angles give zero area and a degenerate figure.
conditions.zh-Hant: 須 a、b＞0 且 0°＜C＜180°；端點角面積為零，是退化圖形。

observation.en: Area follows the altitude, not only the two side lengths.
observation.zh-Hant: 面積隨高改變，並非只由兩邊長決定。

observation.en: Area follows the altitude, not only the two side lengths.

observation.zh-Hant: 邊界角形成退化圖形，並非真正三角形。

title.en: Measure a distance without crossing the river

coreClaim.en: A baseline c with base angles A,B fixes C=180°−A−B. The sine rule gives AC=c sinB/sinC; its perpendicular river width is AC sinA.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 基線 c 及底角 A、B 給出 C＝180°−A−B；正弦定理得 AC＝c sinB/sinC，垂直河寬則為 AC sinA。

conditions.en: c>0,A>0,B>0,A+B<180°. Assume a straight baseline, a common horizontal plane and accurate sighting angles.
conditions.zh-Hant: 須 c＞0、A＞0、B＞0、A＋B＜180°；假設基線直、觀測在同一水平面及角度準確。

observation.en: The sightline AP and perpendicular width are different measurements.
observation.zh-Hant: 視線 AP 與垂直河寬是不同的量。

observation.en: The sightline AP and perpendicular width are different measurements.
observation.zh-Hant: 視線 AP 與垂直河寬是不同的量。

observation.en: Need a positive baseline and A+B<180°, with both angles positive.
observation.zh-Hant: 須基線為正，兩角皆為正且 A＋B＜180°。

title.en: Classify by structure, not by viewpoint

coreClaim.en: Structure determines the class: parallel congruent bases describe prisms or cylinders; a common apex describes pyramids or cones; cutting off a smaller cone gives a frustum. A sphere has no flat base.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 結構決定類別：平行全等底面對應柱體；共頂點對應錐體；截去小錐得到台體；球沒有平底面。

conditions.en: Use nondegenerate solids. A curved surface is not a polygonal face, and the apparent outline changes with viewpoint.
conditions.zh-Hant: 使用非退化立體；曲面不是多邊形面，畫面輪廓會隨視角改變。

observation.en: Rotation changes the image, not the structural classification.
observation.zh-Hant: 旋轉改變圖像，不改變結構分類。

observation.zh-Hant: 旋轉改變圖像，不改變結構分類。

title.en: A drawing does not preserve every length

coreClaim.en: An oblique representation keeps the chosen front axis and scales/reorients depth. Parallel segments remain parallel, but general lengths and angles do not remain true.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 斜二測保留選定的正面軸，並縮短及傾斜縱深；平行線仍平行，一般長度及角度卻不保真。

conditions.en: The picture uses a specified depth scale q>0 and nonparallel projected axes. A collapsed drawing cannot recover depth.
conditions.zh-Hant: 圖須指定正的縱深比例 q，投影兩軸不能平行；壓成一直線後無法由圖恢復縱深。

observation.en: The drawn depth is scaled; do not measure it as a real length.
observation.zh-Hant: 圖上縱深已縮短，不能直接量作真實長度。

observation.en: The drawn depth is scaled; do not measure it as a real length.
observation.zh-Hant: 圖上縱深已縮短，不能直接量作真實長度。

observation.en: The projection has collapsed and lost depth information.
observation.zh-Hant: 投影壓成一直線，遺失縱深資訊。

title.en: A cone height is not its slant height

coreClaim.en: A cylinder unwraps to a rectangle of width2πr and height h. A cone unwraps to a sector with radius ℓ=√(r²+h²) and arc2πr, so its lateral area isπrℓ.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 圓柱側面展成寬 2πr、高 h 的矩形；圓錐展成半徑 ℓ＝√(r²＋h²)、弧長 2πr 的扇形，側面積為 πrℓ。

conditions.en: r>0,h>0. Total surface includes the base: one for a cone,two for a cylinder. Use square units.
conditions.zh-Hant: 須 r＞0、h＞0；總表面積要加底面，圓錐一個、圓柱兩個，單位為平方單位。

observation.en: Use the unwrapped length: slant height for a cone, vertical height for a cylinder.
observation.zh-Hant: 用展開後的長度：圓錐用母線，圓柱用垂直高。

observation.en: Use the unwrapped length: slant height for a cone, vertical height for a cylinder.
observation.zh-Hant: 用展開後的長度：圓錐用母線，圓柱用垂直高。

observation.en: Zero height is a degenerate boundary; the area formula has a limit, not an ordinary solid.
observation.zh-Hant: 零高為退化邊界；面積公式有極限值，並非一般立體。

title.en: The same base and vertical height

coreClaim.en: Vprism=Sh andVcone=Sh/3 use the perpendicular height. The one-third relation is a geometric theorem, not a result proved by a fill animation.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 柱體 V＝Sh、錐體 V＝Sh/3，h 是垂直高；三分之一是幾何定理，不能只靠填滿動畫當證明。

conditions.en: S>0 and h>0 for a solid; h=0 is degenerate and has zero volume. Use cubic units.
conditions.zh-Hant: 立體要求 S＞0、h＞0；h＝0 是退化情況，體積為零，單位為立方單位。

observation.en: Use perpendicular height, not a sloping edge.
observation.zh-Hant: 使用垂直高，不用斜邊。

observation.en: Use perpendicular height, not a sloping edge.
observation.zh-Hant: 使用垂直高，不用斜邊。

observation.en: Zero height collapses the solid.
observation.zh-Hant: 零高使立體退化。

title.en: A frustum is a difference of cones

coreClaim.en: Subtract similar cones to obtain V=πh(R²+Rr+r²)/3. Simply averaging end areas omits the way intermediate cross-sections vary.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 由相似圓錐相減得 V＝πh(R²＋Rr＋r²)/3；只平均上下底面積，會忽略中間截面的變化。

conditions.en: R>0,0≤r≤R,h>0. r=0 gives a cone; r=R gives the cylinder limit.
conditions.zh-Hant: 須 R＞0、0≤r≤R、h＞0；r＝0 為圓錐，r＝R 為圓柱極限。

observation.en: The missing cross-term matters; averaging end areas overestimates.
observation.zh-Hant: 交叉項不能漏；平均上下底面積會高估。

observation.en: Zero top radius gives a cone.
observation.zh-Hant: 上底半徑為零時成為圓錐。

observation.en: Equal radii give the cylinder limit.
observation.zh-Hant: 半徑相等時成為圓柱極限。

title.en: Double a sphere: four or eight times?
title.zh-Hant: 球半徑加倍：四倍還是八倍？

coreClaim.en: A sphere has surface area4πr² and volume4πr³/3. Scaling radius by k changes area by k² and volume by k³.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 球表面積為 4πr²，體積為 4πr³/3；半徑乘 k，面積乘 k²、體積乘 k³。

conditions.en: r>0,k>0 for spheres; k=0 collapses to a point, not a sphere. Area and volume use different units.
conditions.zh-Hant: 球要求 r＞0、k＞0；k＝0 壓成一點，已不是球；面積與體積單位不同。

observation.en: Area uses the square factor; volume uses the cube factor.
observation.zh-Hant: 面積按平方倍數，體積按立方倍數。

observation.en: Area uses the square factor; volume uses the cube factor.
observation.zh-Hant: 面積按平方倍數，體積按立方倍數。

observation.en: The scaled object is a point, not a sphere.
observation.zh-Hant: 縮放後只剩一點，已不是球。

title.en: Which power controls the multiplier?

coreClaim.en: The fixed invariant is y/xⁿ=k. Doubling x multiplies y by 2ⁿ when a ratio is defined. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 不變量為 y/xⁿ=k；比例有定義時，x 加倍令 y 乘 2ⁿ。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: Here x>0 and n∈{1,2,3}. If k=0, both outputs vanish and their ratio is undefined.
conditions.zh-Hant: 此處 x>0、n∈{1,2,3}；k=0 時兩輸出皆零，比值沒有定義。

observation.en: Output multiplier: 2; identity multiplier 2ⁿ=2.
observation.zh-Hant: 輸出比：2；恆等式倍率 2ⁿ=2。

observation.en: Output multiplier: 4; identity multiplier 2ⁿ=4.
observation.zh-Hant: 輸出比：4；恆等式倍率 2ⁿ=4。

observation.en: Output multiplier: undefined (0/0); identity multiplier 2ⁿ=8.
observation.zh-Hant: 輸出比：無定義（0/0）；恆等式倍率 2ⁿ=8。

title.en: A fixed product instead of a fixed ratio

coreClaim.en: The product xy=k is fixed; for nonzero t the new output is y/t. x=0 is excluded. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 乘積 xy=k 固定；非零 t 下，新輸出為 y/t；x=0 被排除。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: x≠0 and t>0; even if k=0, the original expression k/x remains undefined at zero.
conditions.zh-Hant: x≠0、t>0；即使 k=0，原式 k/x 在零仍沒有定義。

observation.en: The fixed product is 4; y(tx)=y(x)/2.
observation.zh-Hant: 固定乘積為 4；y(tx)=y(x)/2。

observation.en: The fixed product is 4; y(tx)=y(x)/2.
observation.zh-Hant: 固定乘積為 4；y(tx)=y(x)/2。

observation.en: x=0 is excluded even when k=0.
observation.zh-Hant: 即使 k=0，x=0 仍被排除。

title.en: Change one factor or both?

coreClaim.en: One doubled factor doubles y; two doubled factors multiply y by four. Zero inputs remain legitimate but can make ratios undefined. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 一個因子加倍使 y 加倍；兩者加倍使 y 乘四；零輸入仍合法，但比值可能無定義。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: k,x,z are real; y/(xz) is used only when xz≠0.
conditions.zh-Hant: k、x、z 為實數；y/(xz) 只在 xz≠0 時使用。

observation.en: Doubling one factor gives 2y; doubling both gives 4y, including zero cases.
observation.zh-Hant: 一個因子加倍得 2y；兩個加倍得 4y，包括零值情況。

observation.en: Doubling one factor gives 2y; doubling both gives 4y, including zero cases.
observation.zh-Hant: 一個因子加倍得 2y；兩個加倍得 4y，包括零值情況。

coreClaim.en: A fixed part a gives y(0)=a. Equal x increments give equal output increments, but output ratios are not generally fixed. Finite displayed cases suggest a conjecture; the justification below states why it holds under the stated conditions.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 固定部分 a 使 y(0)=a；相等輸入增量給相等輸出增量，但輸出比未必固定。 畫面上的有限例子用來形成猜想；下方論證說明它在所列條件下為何成立。

conditions.en: x is nonnegative; a and b are model parameters, not measured empirical facts.

title.en: A parallel line must lie outside the plane

coreClaim.en: A line parallel to a direction inside a plane can either lie in that plane or remain outside it. Strict line-plane parallelism requires no intersection.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 直線方向與面內某線平行，仍可能整條在該面內；嚴格線面平行要求沒有交點。

conditions.en: To use the criterion, the line must lie outside the plane and be parallel to a line within it.
conditions.zh-Hant: 使用判定時，直線須在平面外，並平行於面內一條直線。

observation.en: The direction is parallel and every point remains outside.
observation.zh-Hant: 方向平行，且所有點都在面外。

observation.en: The outside-plane condition fails.
observation.zh-Hant: 「平面外」的條件不成立。

observation.en: A nonzero vertical direction gives one intersection.
observation.zh-Hant: 豎直方向非零，因而有一個交點。

title.en: Two test lines must intersect

coreClaim.en: Two intersecting lines in one plane, each parallel to the other plane, determine two independent directions. Two parallel test lines determine only one direction and can miss a tilt.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 面內兩條相交線各自平行另一平面，才提供兩個獨立方向；兩條平行測試線只有一個方向，可能漏掉傾斜。

conditions.en: The planes must be distinct. Coincident planes are not strictly parallel in the no-intersection convention used here.
conditions.zh-Hant: 兩面須不同；本活動以不相交定義嚴格平行，因此重合不計平行。

observation.en: Two independent directions and distinct planes are required.
observation.zh-Hant: 須檢查兩個獨立方向，且兩面不同。

observation.en: Both parallel x test lines pass, yet the planes intersect.
observation.zh-Hant: 兩條平行 x 測試線均通過，兩面仍相交。

observation.en: Coincidence is excluded from strict parallelism.
observation.zh-Hant: 重合不算嚴格平行。

title.en: Perpendicular to two parallel lines is not enough
title.zh-Hant: 垂直兩條平行線仍不足

coreClaim.en: A line perpendicular to two intersecting lines of a plane is perpendicular to every plane direction. Two parallel lines repeat the same test and do not control the other direction.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 直線垂直面內兩條相交線，才能垂直面內所有方向；兩平行線只是重複測同一方向。

conditions.en: Use a nonzero candidate direction and two genuinely intersecting plane lines.
conditions.zh-Hant: 候選方向須非零，面內兩測試線必須真正相交。

observation.en: Independent tests force the two horizontal components to zero.
observation.zh-Hant: 獨立測試才迫使兩個水平分量同為零。

observation.en: Counterexample: repeated parallel tests miss another plane direction.
observation.zh-Hant: 反例：重複平行方向的測試，漏掉另一面內方向。

observation.en: A zero vector does not define a line direction.
observation.zh-Hant: 零向量不能定義直線方向。

title.en: Perpendicular planes do not make every line normal
title.zh-Hant: 兩面垂直，不代表每條線都垂直

coreClaim.en: Perpendicular planes contain some lines normal to the other plane, but the common hinge line lies in both planes. Other directions can be oblique.
coreClaim.zh-Hant: 垂直兩面內有些線垂直另一面，但共同摺痕在兩面之內；其他方向還可傾斜。

conditions.en: Use the angle between the planes; at fold0° or180° the planes coincide. A candidate line must be tested separately.
conditions.zh-Hant: 使用兩面的夾角；摺角 0° 或 180° 時兩面重合，候選直線仍須另行判定。

observation.en: A plane relation does not replace checking the selected line.
observation.zh-Hant: 平面關係不能代替對選定直線的檢查。

observation.en: The planes are perpendicular, but this line is not normal to the floor.
observation.zh-Hant: 兩面垂直，但這條線並非地面的法線。

observation.en: A plane relation does not replace checking the selected line.
observation.zh-Hant: 平面關係不能代替對選定直線的檢查。
